item.title: Report: Bulls trade Ayo Dosunmu to Minnesota for Rob Dillingham, 4 second-round picks
item.description: CHICAGO — The Chicago Bulls have reportedly traded hometown guard Ayo Dosunmu to the Minnesota Timberwolves for Rob Dillingham and four second-round picks. The Bulls are also trading Julian Phillips and acquiring G League player Leonard Miller from the Timberwolves. The front office has been in a fire sale since Monday ahead of Thursday's deadline. item.title: Residents voice concerns as Hobart takes step forward in building of Amazon data center
